- scripts/repo_root.py:23-36 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistral_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `_has_git_marker` accepts environment-controlled `GIT_DIR`/`GIT_WORK_TREE` paths, allowing trust-boundary manipulation of repo-root validation.
  WHY: The helper resolves and validates attacker-influenced paths after reading the environment, so a malicious CI environment could make an arbitrary location appear as the repository root; x-ai_grok-4_20 disputed this as pre-existing and defensive.

=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- scripts/repo_root.py:23-36 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Path traversal vulnerability through environment variable manipulation of `GIT_DIR`/`GIT_WORK_TREE`.
  WHY: `_has_git_marker` uses `os.environ.get("GIT_DIR")` and `os.environ.get("GIT_WORK_TREE")` without validating that manipulated paths remain within the repository trust boundary, so `.resolve()` can accept attacker-influenced absolute paths.
- scripts/repo_root.py:23-36 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Environment variable manipulation of GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE bypasses repository root validation.
  WHY: Attackers who set `$GIT_DIR` or `$GIT_WORK_TREE` to absolute paths can influence the validation logic, making harmful configurations appear valid at `.resolve()` time.
=== END FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
